{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=Bounty hunter |image=[[File:TredgarVolk-Topps.png]] |name=Tredgar Volk |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 BBY]], [[Daiyu]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}}, which includes Tredgar Volk's [[death]] on [[Daiyu]], to [[9 BBY]]. |species=[[Thuggatoris]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]]{{Kenobi|Part II}} |skin=Gray |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Listen|filename=TredgarVolkDeath-Kenobi2.flac|title=Tredgar Volk's roar|description=Volk, upon being fatally wounded}} '''Tredgar Volk''' was a [[Thuggatoris]] who scraped by as a [[bounty hunter]]. In [[9 BBY]], he spent [[time]] in the courtyard lounge outside [[the Den]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] before going for a [[Diet|meal]] of [[Foodstuff|ribs]] at [[Swartz BBQ]]. As he ate, the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] received a notification informing him of a bounty placed on the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Abandoning his meal, Volk left to [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunt]] for the Jedi. Volk then encountered Kenobi on the [[Daiyu City|city's]] rooftops, where the Jedi was chasing after [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. The alien opened fire on Kenobi, forcing the target into cover as he attempted to return fire and follow the princess. After Kenobi grazed Volk with a shot, the bounty hunter [[LOM-series protocol droid|droid]] [[1-JAC]] joined the fight from another rooftop. Firing on both hunters, Kenobi eventually hit Volk in the chest, [[Death|fatally]] wounding the hunter and causing him to fall to the street below. ==Biography== ===Dino hunter=== {{Quote|Send it across the city. I want every lowlife and bounty hunter on this planet to know Kenobi is here. They only report to me.''"
"''You really think those scum can catch a Jedi?''"
"''I don't want them to catch him. I want them to squeeze him. He'll reveal himself eventually, and I will be waiting.|The Third Sister and Vect Nokru|audio=Sevander-Nokru-Bounty.flac|}} [[File:DinoBountyHunter-KenobiPartII.png|thumb|left|290px|Tredgar Volk was eating ribs when he learned of the bounty on Kenobi.]] Tredgar Volk was a [[Thuggatoris]] that scraped by through [[Bounty hunter|bounty hunting]] as a way of life, getting what{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|subset=Creatures & Aliens|cardname=Tredgar Volk|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/365374/cid/21460627}} he wanted at the end of a [[blaster rifle]]. In [[9 BBY]], Volk was one of many bounty hunters scouting for work on the streets of the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] and was sat with two [[human]]s in a courtyard lounge outside [[the Den]] when the [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached the establishment in [[Search for Princess Leia|search]] of the [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. The [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] was still in the courtyard when the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitor]] known as the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] arrived while [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunting]] Kenobi, and he watched her as she entered the building. When the [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitor]] then left after failing to apprehend Kenobi, Volk was also still seated. Volk later left the courtyard and sat down alone for a [[Diet|meal]] of [[Foodstuff|ribs]] at a street table at [[Swartz BBQ]]. While the bounty hunter ate, the Third Sister had her underling [[Vect Nokru]] post a bounty for Kenobi in the hopes that he would be forced out into the open for her to find by the [[Daiyu City|city's]] various bounty hunters, although she did not expect any of them to be capable of defeating him. Volk received an alert about the bounty via a wrist device and grabbed his [[blaster]] [[rifle]], abandoning the meal. He climbed onto the rooftops of the [[city]] and there encountered Organa, who had been scared by the bounty and was fleeing from Kenobi on a separate rooftop. ===Rooftop shootout=== {{Listen|filename=TredgarVolkGrowl-Kenobi2.flac|title=Tredgar Volk's growl|description=Tredgar Volk growls after being grazed by a shot from Obi-Wan Kenobi}} As Kenobi caught up to Organa, the princess ducked through a [[Clothing|clothesline]] while Volk opened fire on his target, forcing the Jedi to take cover behind a glowing vent. The Jedi then returned fire with a [[blaster pistol]], hitting the wall behind Volk and causing the bounty hunter to duck and cease firing. This gave Kenobi an opening to chase Organa, but Volk quickly began firing again as the Jedi moved across the rooftops after her. After retaking cover, Kenobi fired and grazed the hunter, but Volk just growled and kept firing as the bounty hunter [[LOM-series protocol droid|droid]] [[1-JAC]] also joined the shootout from another rooftop. [[File:TredgarVolkDeath-Kenobi2.png|thumb|right|300px|Tredgar Volk was fatally wounded by Obi-Wan Kenobi.]] Kenobi struggled to fend off the two hunters, firing on both in turn as he called out to Organa, who had reached the edge of a building and was preparing to jump. The Jedi then [[Death|fatally]] shot Volk in the chest, and the bounty hunter let out a screeching roar before tumbling forward off the building and into the street below. Kenobi then evaded 1-JAC while [[Telekinesis|saving]] Organa from a fall after she jumped, with the pair ultimately escaping the bounty hunters and Inquisitors by leaving Daiyu. ==Personality and traits== Tredgar Volk was both [[lizard]] and [[dinosaur]]-like. He had [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s and scaly gray skin. ==Equipment== Volk wore a red [[jacket]] with a black collar and matching red pants, as well as a brown [[belt]] and black [[boot]]s. He used a triple-[[barrel]]ed blaster rifle and had a wrist-device capable of alerting him to bounties. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I named him Falafel (or Phal’afel, if you want it to look more sophisticated) I’m afraid as far as script accuracies go - I was not given one haha. Since I was primarily a stunt performer, I just did as I was told and wasn’t given much info|Cary Gunnar Lee|{{Twitter|url=status/1531400908151566336|username=EinhanderMk2|name=[[Cary Gunnar Lee]]|quote=I named him Falafel (or Phal’afel, if you want it to look more sophisticated) I’m afraid as far as script accuracies go - I was not given one haha. Since I was primarily a stunt performer, I just did as I was told and wasn’t given much info|archivedate=20220530222346}}}} Tredgar Volk was portrayed by creature performer [[Cary Gunnar Lee]]{{Twitter|url=status/1531398964443897856|username=EinhanderMk2|name=[[Cary Gunnar Lee]]|quote=A career milestone and one that will be hard to top. Playing a dinosaur bounty hunter in the #obiwan show|archivedate=20220530221550}} in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series, which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}} Lee's head came up to where Volk's chin and neck met on the costume{{Twitter|url=status/1531405645278089217|username=EinhanderMk2|name=[[Cary Gunnar Lee]]|quote=The entire Dino head haha. My head is roughly where his chin meets neck|archivedate=20220530224252}} and he had issues fitting its fingers through the trigger guard on the character's weapon.{{Twitter|url=status/1531997458103869440|username=EinhanderMk2|name=[[Cary Gunnar Lee]]|quote=I’m not sure how much I’m allowed to reveal but I did not get to keep the rib!Holding the rib was fine but the gun had a trigger guard that my Dino fingers had issues fitting through so I had to really force it through when I picked the gun up|archivedate=20220601135408 }} As it was primarily a stunt based role, Lee did not receive a script, but nicknamed the character [[Wikipedia:Falafel|Falafel]] or "Phal'afel" Prior to the release of the show, Volk was revealed in a teaser trailer that was released on [[March 9]], 2022. Neither the trailer{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} or the series identified the character, with Volk then receiving his name on a card in the [[2023 Topps Disney Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|2023 Topps Disney ''Star Wars Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] set released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] in [[2023]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tredgar Volk|soundcat=Audio files of Tredgar Volk}} *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} {{1stp}} *{{ThisWeek|wAfaGz8SUXU|Obi-Wan Kenobi Teaser Trailer, Behind the Scenes of LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, and More!|sw_url=video/obi-wan-kenobi-teaser-trailer-behind-the-scenes-of-lego-star-wars-the-skywalker-saga-and-more}} *{{SWYouTube|3Yh_6_zItPU|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Disney Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|subset=Creatures & Aliens|cardname=Tredgar Volk|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/365374/cid/21460627}} {{1stID|Tredgar Volk}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Tredgar Volk |ja=トレッガー・ヴォルク |ka=ტრედგარ ვოლკი |pl=Tredgar Volk }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Volk, Tredgar}} [[Category:Bounty hunters]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Thuggatoris]]
